visual.general_description: Four-panel set of bar-and-line charts relating IV fluids or CO2 to blood pH, base excess, oxygen saturation and pH over time.
visual.detailed_description: Figure 1 is a 2 by 2 grid of charts labelled A, B, C and D, each with tan bars and one black line on a second axis. Panels A to C share the legend "Cumulative IV Fluids (L)" and show blood pH, base excess and oxygen saturation by date; panel D shows pH against time and date with a "CO2" line. Calendar dates and clock times on the x-axes are not transcribed.

panels.general_description: Combined bar and line chart of blood pH by date with cumulative IV fluids on a second axis.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A has the bold label A at upper left. A legend at the top reads "Cumulative IV Fluids (L)" beside a short black line. The left y-axis is titled "Blood pH" with ticks 7.0, 7.1, 7.2, 7.3, 7.4, 7.5 and 7.6; the right y-axis is titled "Cumulative IV fluids (L)" with ticks 0, 2, 4, 6 and 8. The x-axis is titled "Date" and carries four angled calendar date labels, one under each of four tan bars. The bars become taller from left to right, with the last two bars of similar height. A straight black line rises across the plot from the first to the last bar.

limitations: The x-axis tick labels are calendar dates (and clock times in panel D); their values are deliberately not transcribed.

visual.general_description: Five point-and-line plots against days for eGFR, creatinine, urea nitrogen, carbon dioxide and cumulative IV fluids.
visual.detailed_description: Five unlettered plots on a white background inside a thin border, arranged as two plots in the top row, two in the middle row and one centered plot in the bottom row. Every plot has black filled circles joined by thin gray line segments and an x-axis titled "Days" with ticks 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30. Top left: y-axis "eGFR (mL/min/1.73m²)" with ticks 0 to 50 in steps of 10; the series falls from its first point to a minimum and then rises steeply, with a brief dip before the final, highest point. Top right: y-axis "Creatinine (mg/dL)" with ticks 0, 5, 10 and 15; the series rises from its first point to a peak and then falls steeply and flattens toward the end. Middle left: y-axis titled as printed "Urea nitrgoen (md/dL)" with ticks 0 to 250 in steps of 50; the series rises slightly, then falls steadily with a flatter tail. Middle right: y-axis "Carbon Dioxide (mmol/L)" with ticks 0, 10, 20 and 30; the series falls to a minimum, then rises to a peak and stays roughly level for the last points. Bottom: y-axis "Cumulative IV fluids (L)" with ticks 0 to 10 in steps of 2; a short series of points rising steadily and covering only part of the x-axis range.
